## 1. Setup

Load the packages and create the output folders.

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse); library(rentrez); library(Biostrings)
library(msa); library(ape); library(phangorn); library(pheatmap); library(here)

set.seed(42)   # reproducibility
for (d in c("data", "figures", "results")) dir.create(here(d), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 2. Download CYTB sequences from NCBI

Search GenBank for each species, keep only full-length sequences with A/C/G/T bases and no premature stop codons, and save them as a FASTA file.

```{r download}
species  <- c("Felis catus", "Felis silvestris", "Panthera leo",
              "Panthera tigris", "Puma concolor")
outgroup <- "Canis lupus"   # dog, used later to root the tree

fetch_cytb <- function(sp, n = 2) {
  term <- sprintf('"%s"[Organism] AND cytb[Gene] AND 1100:1200[SLEN]', sp)
  ids  <- entrez_search(db = "nuccore", term = term, retmax = 30)$ids
  Sys.sleep(0.5)
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NULL)
  fa  <- entrez_fetch(db = "nuccore", id = ids, rettype = "fasta")
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".fasta"); writeLines(fa, tmp)
  s   <- readDNAStringSet(tmp)

  # keep full-length sequences with only A/C/G/T
  acgt <- rowSums(letterFrequency(s, c("A", "C", "G", "T")))
  s <- s[width(s) >= 1130 & width(s) <= 1145 & acgt == width(s)]

  # drop sequences with premature stop codons (vertebrate mitochondrial code)
  prot <- translate(s, genetic.code = getGeneticCode("SGC1"))
  s <- s[!grepl("\\*.", as.character(prot))]

  s <- head(s, n)
  if (length(s) == 0) return(NULL)
  names(s) <- paste0(gsub(" ", "_", sp), "_", sub("\\..*", "", sub(" .*", "", names(s))))
  s
}

seq_list <- lapply(species, fetch_cytb, n = 2)
seq_list <- c(seq_list, list(fetch_cytb(outgroup, n = 1)))
seqs <- do.call(c, seq_list[!sapply(seq_list, is.null)])

writeXStringSet(seqs, here("data", "felid_cytb_sequences.fasta"))
length(seqs)
names(seqs)
width(seqs)
```
